info.title: RELATED PERSON API
info.description: These API's are used to manage related persons information.

get.description: Retrieves detailed information for the related person identified by the incoming clientMemberId, clientOrgName and relatedPersonId.

parameters.name: clientMemberId
parameters.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

parameters.name: clientOrgName
parameters.description: The name of the client organization

parameters.name: relatedPersonId
parameters.description: The related person which will be associated to the member

clientMemberId.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

name.description: The name of the client organization

type.description: Auto-generated type for the phone number

typeDescription.description: Client-defined description for the phone number

primaryIndicator.description: Determines whether this is a primary phone

errorCode.description: The GBL error code that is populated when the exceptionSource is SYSTEM

exceptionSource.description: Characterizes the type of exception (JSON, SYSTEM, PARAMETER)

type.description: Auto-generated type for the email address

typeDescription.description: Client-defined description for the email address

emailAddress.description: Email address - any notifications will be sent to this email address

primaryIndicator.description: Determines whether this is a primary email address

line1.description: The first line of the address

line2.description: The (optional) second line of the address

attentionCareOf.description: If the address is 'in-care-of' someone else

line3.description: The (optional) third line of the address

line4.description: The (optional) fourth line of the address

primaryIndicator.description: Determines whether this is a primary address

returnMailIndicator.description: Indicated whether the member’s address has had mail returned

clientOrg.description: The name of the client organization

allocationPercentage.description: The percentage allocated to the beneficiary
